g.title: app_lifecycle
g.text: install → prepare → setup → ready; apps call /v1 and never own model start/stop

g.title: fetch
g.text: platform command · default bundles · pinned version

g.title: planned
g.text: written to apps.json before the install command

g.title: cmd
g.text: run: daemon executes the shell command
client: desktop runs it; daemon only records
URL: show the download page; skip: do not execute

g.title: failed
g.text: cached bundles kept; retry = POST install again

g.title: setup
g.text: set state=ready, then run setup scripts
scripts: saved plan / SHA-256 verify / ordered run
script failure writes setup_error; state stays ready

g.title: note
g.text: client commands / installers run locally, then POST install
apps have no PID / child endpoint and cannot start/stop models

g.title: ready
g.text: Connection in apps.json; APIKey is always local

g.title: uninstall
g.text: by default removes the registry entry only
shared assets kept; never stops a resident

g.title: uninstalled
g.text: model cache / logs / setup-cache kept by default
